_comment: Music catalog for the one live station, 97.8 THE SQUATCH, plus direct scene cues. Runtime playlist selection uses `cue` and exact `venue`; unscoped non-cue tracks enter 97.8's record pool. Historical `station` values (`uncle` / `ksqch`) are retained only as unresolved legacy metadata and do not create dial positions or filter playback. Do not revive or remove those identities until the owner decides their future.
_credits_comment: THE CREDITS SONG is Big Feet on the Dance Floor, the Front & Center opener, in full — owner's ruling of 2026-09-02, which replaced the earlier 'Down at the Bada Bing' pick (that file never landed; its staged row stays below as the delivery example). resolveCreditsMusicSrc (src/core/campaign-credits-view.js) finds the one `credits: true` row and the crawl plays it; `cue: true` keeps it off 97.8's rotation. Never list a file that is not on disk.

tracks._comment: Plays from the top and gets exactly 15 seconds before the station cuts it dead into the authored jerky ad. `start` pins it to 0 so the 15s is the recording's 15s, not 15s from wherever the usual drop-in landed. The edit is unconditional on every receiver and does not depend on campaign notices.

tracks.title: Big Feet on the Dance Floor
tracks._note: The first 27 seconds only in Front & Center, immediately after the band's opening joke; it fades directly into Bananaphone. ALSO THE CREDITS SONG, in full -- owner, 2026-09-02: "It's the same song we use in the opening of the Front and Center mission when the band goes on stage. I just want the full song." The credits view (src/core/campaign-credits-view.js) plays the file straight through on `credits: true`; `cutAt` is the supper club's edit and does not apply there, and the crawl stretches to the song's length.

tracks.title: Initiation Cabin Stereo
tracks._note: Purpose-built slow old-cabin instrumental. Positional and muffled outside, open inside, then faded before the oath; it is never station programming.

tracks.title: Enola Pre-Bomb-Drop Approach
tracks._note: Non-diegetic approach score. The mission aligns its ending to bomb release and hard-cuts it if the release happens early.

tracks.title: Enola Escape After Drop
tracks._note: Non-diegetic escape score. It starts only after the explosion and its authored silent aftermath have landed.
